title: Ryanair Flies Empty Plane to Marrakech, Stranding Passengers in France — Your Rights Explained
body:
Dozens of passengers were stranded at a French airport after a Ryanair flight departed for Marrakech without them following an uncommunicated gate change. The incident is under review by French aviation authorities.

Your Rights

Under EU Regulation 261/2004, passengers denied boarding are entitled to: 600 EUR compensation (flights over 3,500km), meals and hotel if overnight stay required, re-routing or full refund. Submit a complaint to Ryanair first; escalate to the DGAC (France) if unresolved within 6 weeks.

Source: Kech24, passenger reports. EU261 guidance from European Commission.
